gaps.sentence: Try to be ___ when you cross the busy road (CARE).
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed after 'be': careful (-ful). 'Carefully' is an adverb and cannot follow 'be'.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (INVENT) of the new engine worked day and night.
gaps.explanation: The person who worked day and night is the inventor; 'invention' is the thing created.

gaps.sentence: This guidebook is really ___ for travellers (USE).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ful means full of: useful. 'Useless' is the negative opposite.

gaps.sentence: He is under a lot of ___ at work (PRESS).
gaps.hint: noun needed after 'a lot of'; fixed phrase 'under ___'
gaps.explanation: 'Under pressure' is the fixed phrase; the noun of 'press' is 'pressure'.

gaps.sentence: The festival celebrates ___ (CREATE) in every form.
gaps.explanation: 'Celebrates creativity' — the abstract quality noun follows the verb.

gaps.sentence: The vaccine is still awaiting official ___ (APPROVE).
gaps.explanation: 'Official approval' — the noun form follows the adjective.

gaps.sentence: It was the most ___ (FORGET) trip of my life.
gaps.hint: negative adjective: too good to forget
gaps.explanation: 'Unforgettable' = impossible to forget; 'forgetful' describes a person who forgets.
